component.name: tomi Web Browser
component.summary: The web browser from tomi project

description.p: tomi is an open-source browser project that aims to build a safer, faster, and more stable way to experience the web.
tomi supports Vorbis, Theora, WebM and HTML5 audio and video standards, but does not include the non-free AAC, H.264, MP3 or Adobe Flash code that is found in Chrome.
